tasks.name: Delegate and complete a monthly report
tasks.goal: Request the April MUFG report and complete only the necessary human decisions
steps: Describe the business outcome in natural language
Review the Agent's matched context and execution intent
Resolve the AUM conflict using provenance and recommendation
Verify completion, artifacts, decision, approval, and audit evidence
tasks.success_truth: The correct April MUFG report is completed and its governed evidence remains accessible
tasks.result_destination: Focused execution workspace and durable operation history

tasks.name: Create governed repeat automation
tasks.goal: Create, review, publish, and schedule a repeatable Flow through the Agent
preconditions: Permission to publish a prototype Flow
steps: Verify the Flow, version, schedule, and future execution context
tasks.success_truth: One governed Flow and one active Schedule exist without duplicate records

tasks.name: Monitor and recover an execution
tasks.goal: Find an execution needing attention and choose a safe recovery or stop action
steps: Locate an execution by Flow and status
Inspect the business blocker and audit context
Open Agent Workspace when business input is required
Choose upload, continue search, retry, resume, rerun, or cancel
Verify the new status and retained audit history
tasks.success_truth: The selected execution reaches an intentional next state without losing evidence
tasks.result_destination: Execution detail and linked Agent conversation

assumptions: Current prototype intentionally uses local scripted responses
Publish, approval, and cancellation are safe prototype mutations
The evaluation will not claim real external delivery or production scheduling
